name: chronista-hub-workspace
description: Chronista Hub — World Tree meta-registry for the Chronista ecosystem

scripts.gen: bun packages/cli/bin/kdl-schema.ts gen docs/spec/world-tree.kdl --target all --output-dir generated/

scripts.gen:zod: bun packages/cli/bin/kdl-schema.ts gen docs/spec/world-tree.kdl --target zod -o generated/world-tree.schema.ts
